facts.fact: ICT Minister Tatenda Mavetera said the Presidential Internet Scheme is rolling out free Wi-Fi hotspots in town centres, post offices and community halls, with Manicaland and Mashonaland East having received and deployed kits.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services

facts.fact: The Herald reports that the ICT Ministry handed 250 Starlink kits to the Ministry of Local Government and Public Works for local authorities, whose deployment now rests with that ministry; no kit is stated in use.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services

facts.fact: ICT Minister Tatenda Mavetera said the President personally approved the licensing of low-earth-orbit satellite technology in Zimbabwe, which made the Starlink kit deployment possible.
